definitions.gloss: minor role; bit part; supporting role
definitions.explanation: A small, unimportant role in a play, film, or drama — one with few lines and little screen time. By extension, can describe a marginal or insignificant position in any endeavor.

examples.japanese: {端役|はやく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{出演|しゅつえん}→出演：11732_shutsuen⟧⟦できて→できる：00557_dekiru⟧うれしい。
examples.english: I'm happy even to appear in a minor role.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{端役|はやく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{主役|しゅやく}→主役：04199_shuyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She grew from bit parts all the way to leading roles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{端役|はやく}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧だったそうだ。
examples.english: Even famous actors apparently had nothing but minor roles when they were young.

notes:
Compound of {端|は} ('edge; margin; peripheral') and ⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧ ('role; part'). The word evokes a position at the margins of the main action — someone who appears briefly without driving the story.

USAGE:
- Primarily used in theater, film, and television contexts
- Can be used figuratively to describe a person playing an insignificant part in a project or event
- Often contrasted with ⟦{主役|しゅやく}→主役：04199_shuyaku⟧ ('leading role') or {大役|たいやく} ('important role')
- The story arc of rising from {端役|はやく} to stardom is a common narrative in entertainment industry stories

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {端役|はやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じる→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧: to play a minor role
- {端役|はやく}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧: nothing but minor roles
- {端役|はやく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{始|はじ}める: to start from minor roles
- {端役|はやく}⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧: bit-part actor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脇役|わきやく}→脇役：13933_wakiyaku⟧: supporting role — a more significant secondary role that contributes to the plot, unlike the marginal {端役|はやく}
- ⟦{主役|しゅやく}→主役：04199_shuyaku⟧: leading role; protagonist — the antonym; the central role in a production
- エキストラ: extra — a background performer with no lines, even smaller than a {端役|はやく}
